name: What the Forest Carries
theme: Stewardship; understanding before action; preserve, do not conquer.
signature_encounter: The Eight-Round Defense of the Living Ward

stages.title: The Silent Forest
stages.description: The forest has gone unnaturally quiet. Birds, deer and even insects have fled. Something at its heart is failing.

objectives.description: Investigate why the forest has fallen silent.
Track the direction the wildlife fled.

steps.text: No birdsong. No wind through the leaves that should carry it. The Mossroot say the forest is holding its breath.

nodes.speaker: Elder Vess
nodes.text: Outsider. The forest carries our dead, our memory, our covenant. Now it carries a sickness we cannot reach. Will you understand before you act?

choices.label: [Insight] The silence spreads outward from one point, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Elder Vess
nodes.text: You listen with your whole mind. Yes -- it spreads from the Living Ward at Heartgrove. Corwin knows the paths; trust his reading of them.

nodes.speaker: Elder Vess
nodes.text: The Living Ward -- the ancient enchantment that keeps the Sleeping Warden at peace -- is failing. If it breaks, the Warden wakes in agony, corrupted.

steps.prompt: You read the forest floor for the wildlife's escape routes.

on_failure.text: The trails scatter and fade, but they all lead away from Heartgrove.

stages.title: Mother's Crossing
stages.description: A river ford sacred to the Mossroot, where the corruption's edge first becomes visible.

objectives.description: Cross Mother's Crossing and reach the Heartgrove path.

steps.text: At Mother's Crossing the water runs grey. Corwin kneels, presses a palm to the current, and grimaces.

steps.prompt: The safe stones are hidden beneath grey water. How do you cross?

options.label: Let Corwin read the safe path.
Pick your own way across, slowly and carefully.

effects.text: You cross soaked and shivering, but you cross.

stages.title: Heartgrove and the Failing Ward
stages.description: At the forest's heart stands the Living Ward -- and beneath it, the colossal Sleeping Warden, stirring in corrupted pain.

objectives.description: Discover why the Living Ward is failing.

steps.text: Heartgrove: a cathedral of ancient trees. The Living Ward flickers like a guttering candle. Below it, something the size of a hill breathes unevenly -- the Sleeping Warden, a guardian of stone, wood, moss, root and earth.

steps.prompt: You study the Ward's failing weave.

on_success.text: You understand: the Ward is not broken, it is exhausted. It can be renewed by a ritual -- but only if it is defended while it works.

on_failure.text: Corwin fills the gaps in your reading: the Ward must be renewed by ritual, and defended while it works.

stages.title: Two Burdens
stages.description: The Mossroot must be evacuated from the collapse radius while the Ward is renewed. The party must divide.

objectives.description: Divide the party between the ritual and the evacuation.

steps.text: There is not time for both tasks with one group. Corwin, who knows the ritual, should go forward. Others must shield the fleeing Mossroot.

stages.title: Defend the Living Ward
stages.description: The renewal ritual takes eight rounds. It ends when the ritual succeeds -- not when the last enemy falls.

objectives.description: Protect the ritual for all eight rounds.
Keep the sacred saplings from being trampled.

steps.text: Corwin begins the renewal chant. Corrupted roots and thorn-beasts erupt from the treeline. Hold.

spec.name: The Eight-Round Defense of the Living Ward
escalation: Corrupted roots erupt beneath the circle.
Grasping vines reach for the saplings.
A tide of hollow woodland folk arrives.
The ground itself heaves as the Warden thrashes.
The corruption throws everything at the failing Ward.
Final surge -- the Ward flares as the renewal takes hold.

stages.title: The Sleeping Warden
stages.description: The Warden is not to be slain but saved -- freed from corruption as the renewed Ward takes hold.

objectives.description: Free the Sleeping Warden from corruption.

steps.text: The renewed Ward blazes. The Warden's colossal eyes clear of blight. It regards you -- ancient, weary, grateful -- and settles back into its long dream.

steps.prompt: As the Warden calms, how do you close the rite?

options.label: Let Corwin speak the Mossroot word of rest.
Stand in silent respect as it sleeps.

stages.title: The Forest Breathes
stages.description: The party regroups. The forest, slowly, begins to wake.

steps.text: Birdsong returns, tentative, then certain. Elder Vess bows -- not to a savior, but to a steward who understood before acting.
